propositions: PASS-path idempotent_reuse synthesizes empty advisory/coaching/indeterminate lists instead of replaying stored REVIEW_RESULT sidecar findings, causing loss of the last review's actual findings.
BLOCK-path verdict_reuse already replays stored blocking/advisory/coaching with reuse notation; PASS path must achieve parity.
Plan-review CLI rendering must disambiguate replayed findings (unchanged plan, no LLM re-run) from fresh review results and cite the stored review's recency anchor when available.

Sidecar-backed replay must degrade gracefully to empty lists when sidecar is absent, unreadable, mismatched in fingerprint, or contradicts the valid attestation; attestation remains the validity authority.
Both reuse paths must populate coverage.replayed_review with verified_at_sha and reviewed_at from the stored sidecar to enable staleness judgment.
